question: Does the bounded public tail deletion on a DAO-created original preserve all bytes except its directory word/free-byte/TDEF-count fields, and match DAO deletion plus a subsequent insert despite keeping page0 unchanged?
source_facts: EXP-0162 tail tombstone, count, free-byte, maps and continuation; page0 bytes observed but uninterpreted
EXP-0152 public Unix field-update publication and existing-file/query preservation
sequence: Commit and independently review pinned inputs before a single coordinated acquisition. No same-plan retry or phase resume.

Phase create: nine fresh DAO originals, each with Items/Later and KeepQuery; close all writable handles. Copy each original for one DAO delete of the unique selected Id. Retain read-only original/control snapshots and closed images.

Require complete correct phase1 and unchanged transfers. Unix exporter uses public reader to select unique Id/locator, copies original, and invokes public delete_row once. Independently bind raw row/page/root and exact patch; preserve the original, all deleted payload/slack and page0.

Only nine valid Rust deletions allow phase observe. Read originals/control/Rust copies read-only, then create separate control-next and rust-next copies and insert the exact declared row through DAO. Capture every resulting file read-only; original/control/Rust baseline images remain unchanged.

Original/control phase1 and all five roles phase2 give63 capture records and45 retained MDBs. Compare complete expected schemas/rows, relation/index absence, original exact stored QueryDef SQL and full metadata. Match Rust vs DAO control both after delete and follow-on insert; compare original/control/Rust table map membership. Retain all raw files, receipts and operation/error results.
decision_rule: observed_accepted only when all phases/operations/captures and nine Unix receipts are complete, all input/image/source identities match, all requested snapshots match and exact Rust patch/payload/slack/page0 preservation succeeds. Any mismatch/incomplete phase/native/public failure gives no_outcome, without accepting subsets. Pin mismatches reject analysis. No normalized floating values or inferred header counters.
bounds: Three finite unindexed, relationship-free, non-Auto/LVAL target tables with consistent source free metadata; last physical slot and at least2live rows. Small constant/mixed Text widths only. Existing decoder64rows/page and64pages bounds are sufficient. SSH phases300seconds, Unix exporter120seconds; no acquisition retry. No arbitrary deletion grammar, tombstone reuse/page release, hosted compatibility or support movement.
hypothesis: Page zero remains byte-identical in Rust-deleted files, unlike observed DAO bookkeeping changes. Its semantics are not guessed. Deleted row payload and slack are deliberately retained. Acceptance and continuing DAO use are experimental questions.
producer: Unix public delete_row from reviewed source, one copy/operation per original. Result source_revision binds declared reviewed source and pinned relevant files; acquisition_revision records actual committed harness. No binary/build attestation.
